videos.caption: This is how dropshipping actually works: First, you create your online store. You can do this with Shopify for $1/month. I also recommend connecting it to pagepilot.ai so you can just have AI design the store for you. Next, you sign up for Zendrop and link it to Shopify. Zendrop is your supplier. Essentially, they stock the product you're selling on your store. Then, when somebody buys the product on your store, Zendrop is notified, and they package up the product and ship it to your customer. You don't have to touch the product once. This way, you don't have to spend thousands buying a bunch of inventory. You only pay Zendrop once the customer has paid you first. #ecom #entrepreneur #business #shopify #onlinebusiness
